ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
Many television screens are rectangles that are measured by the length of their diagonals. The ratio of the horizontal length to the height in a standard television screen is $ 4 : 3$. The horizontal length of a “$ 27$-inch” television screen is closest, in inches, to which of the following?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a rectangular television screen. A diagonal runs from the lower-left corner to the upper-right corner, forming a right triangle with the bottom side labeled Length and the right side labeled Height. Reasoning: The horizontal length to height ratio is 4:3, so let the horizontal length be 4k and the height be 3k. The diagonal is the hypotenuse of this right triangle, so the side ratio is 4:3:5. Since the diagonal is 27 inches, 5k = 27, so k = 27/5 = 5.4. The horizontal length is 4k = 4(5.4) = 21.6 inches, which is closest to 21.5 inches.
